art_instructions: Draw a medium shot from eye level showing the Dinosaur standing in a friendly, upright posture with a wide, encouraging smile. His big expressive eyes should look directly at the viewer, conveying helpfulness and cheer. Keep his three stubby fingers clearly visible, perhaps with one raised as if speaking. Do not include any background details or other characters. The Dinosaur should be drawn in the Korean aegyo cute style: chibi proportions (2–3 heads tall), rounded silhouette, smooth monoline strokes (2–4 px at 1080p), dark brown/charcoal lines, and flat pastel green color with a pale mint belly. Add simple glossy highlights to his eyes and a faint blush dot on his cheeks to emphasize his gentle, childlike friendliness.
